html:
Maintaining the pristine appearance of a Tesla requires a protective solution that matches the vehicle’s advanced engineering. The factory clear coat on these vehicles is susceptible to environmental wear, making professional paint protection a valuable investment for long-term ownership. EliteX Graphene Surface Protection provides a high-tensile barrier designed to defend your vehicle from the harsh Australian elements while enhancing its gloss.

ite

Advanced Nanotechnology of EliteX Graphene Protection

The EliteX Graphene Infused formula represents a significant advancement over traditional silica-based coatings. By creating a hybrid formula that combines silicon dioxide and silicon carbide with graphene, this coating achieves exceptional hardness and bonding capability. Graphene itself is a layer of carbon just one atom thick, yet it provides remarkable tensile strength and flexibility.

When professionally applied, the coating bonds deeply into the microscopic pores of your Tesla’s paintwork. This chemical bond creates a surface that is noticeably smoother to the touch and optically shinier, enhancing the depth of the paint colour. Furthermore, the thermal resistance of this graphene hybrid formula is approximately double that of conventional ceramic coatings, offering superior protection against intense heat and sun exposure.

Environmental Damage Resistance for Tesla Paintwork

The exterior surfaces of your vehicle are constantly exposed to environmental hazards that can degrade the clear coat over time. EliteX Graphene paint protection is designed to shield both the clear and base coats from these common threats.

This professional treatment helps prevent several types of damage:

  • Weather-induced oxidisation, fading, and loss of gloss caused by exposure to intense solar radiation.
  • Clear coat delamination and base coat deterioration.
  • Chemical etching from acidic substances including bird droppings, bat droppings, and tree sap.
  • Stains from stubborn bug splatter, fallen leaves, and industrial rail dust.
  • Hard water spots and bore water marks that can mar the paint finish.

By establishing a sacrificial barrier on top of the factory paint, the coating absorbs these environmental impacts, preserving the original finish underneath.

Maintenance and Protective Film Integration

A key advantage of this nanotechnology is its hydrophobic performance. The coating creates a high contact angle for water, causing rain and moisture to form tight beads that roll off the surface easily. As these water droplets move across the paintwork, they carry away loose dirt, dust, and road grime. This self-cleaning effect results in a low-maintenance surface that simplifies regular washing.

While the hydrophobic properties make cleaning easier, regular gentle washing is still necessary to prevent a build-up of traffic film. It is also helpful to understand the physical limitations of ceramic coatings. Although EliteX provides extreme hardness against environmental elements and light abrasions, it cannot absorb the high-velocity impact of flying road debris.

For maximum paintwork security, combining ceramic protection with a physical barrier is highly recommended. Applying Paint Protection Film (PPF) to vulnerable areas, such as the front bumper and bonnet, provides robust protection against stone chips and deep scratches. Tesla owners can use our premium Car Care products to maintain the coating’s hydrophobicity and mirror-like shine over time.

EliteX Professional Application and Warranty Details

EliteX Graphene Paint Protection is a professional-grade treatment that requires skilled preparation and application. Unlike retail wax products, this permanent coating is applied in a controlled environment by trained technicians to ensure a flawless bond with the paint.

Every EliteX application includes:

  • Decontamination of the paint surface to remove embedded road grime and microscopic particles.
  • Paint correction to eliminate minor swirls and light scratches, ensuring the highest possible gloss before sealing.
  • A nationwide limited lifetime warranty, providing peace of mind that your vehicle is protected for as long as you own it.
  • No requirement for annual inspections or costly maintenance packages to keep the warranty valid.
